Ben / Jonas — I put together an acceptance criteria draft and a handful of mitigations. Key points below (full doc attached):

- Acceptance gates (high level):
  • Canary A (internal): smoke + defined latency and correctness checks (24-48h).
  • Canary B (prod slice): real traffic slice, SLA verification, customer signoff window (48-72h).
  • Final signoff: Helios acceptance test suite pass, security signoff, and no P1/P2 defects outstanding.
- Credit/escrow proposal: tiered credit (10% per major missed milestone up to 30%), with a partial DocuSign hold to trigger automatic credit release if final acceptance is not achieved by the escrow date.
- Runbook owner: I will take operational ownership for the canaries and post-canary triage.
- Short-term mitigations I recommend we adopt now: pre-merge smoke gating, a dedicated integration slot for Helios on our next QA weekend, and a daily 9am stand for the two-week finalization window.

I attached acceptance_criteria_draft.docx and included a small risk excerpt in this thread (see risk_log_snapshot.pdf). I’ll coordinate with QA to reserve the slot — Jonas, please confirm finance acceptance for the credit mechanics so we can include the language in the DocuSign.
